Now, a study published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences has analyzed over a decade of this data to determine whether the daily and seasonal changes in Mars' atmosphere could be explained by known processes, including the freezing and release of carbon dioxide at its poles. What they found suggests a process involving water either attached to soil grains or in extremely thin, liquid-like films at the surface.

It said simply: “The bridge is fucked.” He then added: “We will stand and Moscow will fall.” It was a freezing night, with a bright starry sky and no clouds. Lines of ice had formed on the drone’s bulky wings. Soon, it would be hurtling towards its target – about 500km to the south. Typically the soldiers who gathered in this muddy field in central Ukraine were attacking oil refineries deep inside Russia. In recent months the work had become almost mundane: they had hit so many of them. The objective that evening, however, was unique. This sharp luminescence makes this material a promising candidate for implementing on-chip quantum light sources.

For background, the Census Bureau’s Manufacturing and Trade Inventories and Sales report, known as business inventories, is released monthly at 10 am ET about six weeks after the reference month ends. It combines inventories and sales across the three main stages of the goods supply chain: manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers. Much of the report is known by the time it’s released. Manufacturing inventories come out in the factory orders report, and advance estimates for wholesale and retail inventories are published about two weeks earlier in the Advance Economic Indicators release. items.title: US October industrial production -0.4% vs +0.1% expected
items.summary: Prior was +0.7% Capacity utilization 76.4% vs 76.8% exp Manufacturing output +0.3% vs +0.2% expected Prior manufacturing output +0.3% Mining -0.8% vs +0.2% prior Utilities -4.3% vs +3.5% prior Y/y +2.1% vs +2.25% prior Utilities caused the miss. They gave back September’s weather-driven 4.4% jump: electric output fell 4.2% and natural gas utilities fell 4.7%. The utility operating rate fell 3.3 points to 70.2%. Even so, electric output is still up 2.0% y/y. Deeper into the report, there are good signs. Motor vehicles and parts rose 4.4% after falling 2.7% in September. Semiconductor output rose 2.2% m/m and is up 15.3% y/y (though that's likely driven by pricing, not volumes). Business equipment was up 1.0%, and +7.8% y/y so that's a good sign on future productivity. The annual revision is due November 24 and will rebase the index to 2022, so expect these numbers to be redrawn next week.

Andy Burnham urges caution on lifting the Saturday 3pm TV blackout in the UK, saying the health of the football pyramid should come first. Andy Burnham has urged caution on lifting the Saturday 3pm TV blackout in the UK, saying the health of the football pyramid should come first. The rule was introduced in the 1960s to encourage fans to attend lower league games and prevents matches from being shown on UK television between 2:45pm and 5:15pm on Saturdays. The blackout, which is enforced by Article 48 of the Uefa Statutes and is imposed by the English and Scottish football associations, comes into effect when 50% of fixtures in the top two divisions are scheduled to kick off at 3pm.

Nearly 2,200 migrants arrived by boat in Spain’s Canary Islands over two days, according to the country’s maritime rescue service. On Sunday, November 15, rescue teams assisted migrants aboard crowded boats off the island of El Hierro, helping passengers, including a baby, disembark safely at port facilities. The Maritime Rescue Service said it had assisted 1,324 people aboard 14 boats, most of whom arrived on El Hierro. The figure was close to the daily record for the Atlantic migration route, set in November 2020.

Spain says nearly 2,200 migrants reached the Canary Islands in two days, with most arriving on the small island of El Hierro. Nearly 2,200 migrants have reached Spain’s Canary Islands by boat over the past two days, Spain’s maritime rescue service said on Sunday. The archipelago off northwest Africa is a major entry point for migrants, mainly from West Africa, attempting the dangerous Atlantic crossing in makeshift boats. More than 13,000 of the just over 28,000 people who arrived in Spain by sea between January and the end of October landed in the Canary Islands, according to the Interior Ministry.

Telling people to set aside food, water and cash is all very well, but we need a truly joined-up resilience strategy – and we don’t have one, says Jean Coussins, chair of the Lords national resilience committee T he public has been stocking up on bottled water, tinned food and wind-up radios since the government launched its Be Ready campaign last month. But it’s not the public’s willingness to prepare that should worry us. What’s missing is the government’s willingness to provide candid information about the escalating nature and frequency of the threats we face, and a coherent resilience plan that can be activated from the top of government to local, community and household levels.

Andrew Luck knew what his Indianapolis Colts coaches were talking about, and he didn't need notes as a reminder. "I go back to his interview out of Stanford. We put some plays on the board and worked out," Arians said. "All right, I said, 'Put 62 Y Choice back up there,' and he's drawing it. Boom. Initially dedicated to grumbles, the show's unique format was soon expanded to include praise. Speaking at Monday's unveiling, Praise or Grumble's longest-running presenter Andy Giddings said: "It's not about who sits in the chair, it's about the people who get involved. That's why it's still going strong after 40 years."

Credit freeze, fraud alert or identity monitoring? After a data breach, the right identity theft protection depends on what information was exposed. All estimates of human spaceflight on Starship should be taken with a gigantic grain of salt. However, it raises other questions. The short answer is pretty simple: If SpaceX prioritizes human spaceflight on Starship, it could happen reasonably quickly. The longer answer becomes more complicated and depends on what one means by human spaceflight. The first people to fly on Starship probably won’t launch from Earth, or land here. Rather, they will probably be NASA’s lunar astronauts. So there are different timelines for humans flying aboard Starship and landing on Earth.

Michigan Football took another major step back in ESPN’s SP+ rankings following the loss to Oregon. Here’s where things stand with two weeks left: For those of you who might be new to SP+, it's an advanced metric that takes into account a team's offensive, defensive, and special teams efficiencies. It combines all three metrics into one uniform metric that predicts how many points a given team would defeat (or lose to) the "average" college football team by on a neutral field. In other words, it's a metric designed to look at how "good" teams really are at different aspects of the game rather than ranking them purely on their resumes.

All 32 NHL teams saw increases in valuation, per CNBC. The Mammoth's total franchise value, per the report, now sits at $1.85 billion, making them the 27th-most-valuable team in the league. That's up from $1.6 billion the previous year, and significantly higher than the the $1.2 billion Smith Entertainment Group reportedly paid for the team in 2024. That type of growth wasn't exclusive to the Mammoth. In fact, all 32 NHL teams increased in value, and the Mammoth were tied for the third-least growth of them all. Ken "Bulldog" Sanders, a standout on the first three Milwaukee Brewers teams who stayed in the area after his playing days, died at 85. The St. Louis-born Sanders spent 10 seasons in Major League Baseball, including the first three seasons of the Milwaukee Brewers' existence from 1970 through 1972, when he had a 2.21 ERA and 61 saves. He continued living in the Milwaukee area after his time in the big leagues. "Bulldog" – a nickname bestowed by former Brewers manager Dave Bristol – led the American League with 31 saves in 1971 and posted a 1.91 ERA and 1.064 WHIP, even earning MVP votes that season.

Drought conditions and low reservoir levels are affecting the renewable power source. The US Southwest generated 28% less electricity via hydropower between April and August than the 10-year average, according to new data from the US Energy Information Administration. Most hydropower plants in the US rely on dams to hold back water, creating reservoirs. The water can be released through turbines, generating electricity on demand. But an extreme, prolonged drought in the Colorado River Basin has resulted in dangerously low water levels in the Southwest’s two largest reservoirs, affecting the availability of this power source.

(AP) — USA Swimming will integrate the sport's Paralympic system into its own organization next year as part of an ongoing push in the U. to bring Paralympic sports closer to their roots ahead of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
